mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_processing_record WHERE process_status = 'PROCESSING' AND start_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY start_time ASC
SELECT * FROM settlement_processing_record WHERE process_status = 'PROCESSING' AND start_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{thresholdMinutes} MINUTE) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY start_time ASC

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN process_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN process_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failedCount, AVG(processing_duration) as avgDuration, MAX(processing_duration) as maxDuration, MIN(processing_duration) as minDuration FROM settlement_processing_record WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time)
